reporting-org.narrative: Internationella Kvinnoförbundet för Fred och Frihet

description.narrative: WILPF DRC are partners to WILPF Sweden (IKFF) and one of the organisations implementing the Transformative Partnership Program (TPP). WILPF DRC plays a strategic role in promoting inclusive peace, youth and women's participation, and in advocating with policymakers and key actors involved in the implementation of the YPS Agenda. The TPP funding is primarily aimed at strengthening WILPF DRC as an organisation, providing administrative and salary support essential to its sustainable operation. This support will enable WILPF DRC to have stable and qualified human resources capable of effectively planning, coordinating and implementing its strategic objectives. In particular, staff salary funding will strengthen the organisation's capacity to scale up its advocacy efforts, including through more regular and strategic participation in meetings with policymakers, institutional partners, YPS national mechanisms and other relevant stakeholders.
